candidate_wording: A complaint that a control feels unresponsive may arise from missing acknowledgement even when system latency is low.
culture_relevance_rationale: The basic mechanism may be broad, but conventions for visible acknowledgement and animation can vary by platform and context.
discriminator: Measure action-to-acknowledgement time separately from action-to-completion time and inspect the visible state change.
reversal_condition: If acknowledgement is immediate and salient while users still report the same failure, missing acknowledgement is not sufficient to explain the complaint.
